Morrissey Associates, Inc.Employer: Costa Mesa, CA, USLocation: Thu, Nov 12 '26Posted on: Full-timeType:
Morrissey Associates, Inc. is a full-service architectural studio primarily serving educational clients. Our practice is committed to creating meaningful, human-centered architectural environments, executed with rigor and guided by our clients’ goals. This commitment is grounded in a collaborative studio culture where every individual contributes ideas, shares responsibility for projects, and advances their professional growth.
We are currently seeking a Senior Architect to join our team in Costa Mesa!
Responsibilities
Lead a collaborative design process through all phases of assigned projects
Lead client and team meetings through all phases of assigned projects
Coordinate design, review and QA process
Interface with Authorities Having Jurisdiction to attain project approvals
Oversee construction administration phase
Implement and monitor project budgets, scopes, and schedules
Track and review client and consultant contracts and additional services
Candidate Qualities
A positive, collaborative approach to working with all team members
Ability to structure and manage project goals and deadlines
Ability to convey design concepts and explain technical execution
Experience & Technical Skills
10+ years of professional experience in architectural design and construction
Experience in the K-12 sector preferred
5+ years of California education experience
Extensive knowledge of the CBC and Title 5
Experience with DSA and local Authorities Having Jurisdiction
Experience in construction administration
Working knowledge of Revit and AutoCAD
Education & Credentials
Architectural degree
California Registered Architect is preferred
LEED BD+C certification is preferred
Compensation, Benefits & Details
Competitive salary plus bonuses based on experience, qualifications, and performance
Health Insurance
401k matching plan
Holidays, Vacation, and Sick Leave
This position is full-time and in person
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States
